description: The U.S.S. Socrates is named after a famed human thinker who has had a lasting impact on moral and ethical philosophy. Interestingly, Socrates was widely criticized and ridiculed during his lifetime, a parallel that is not lost on the Forsaken. With its compact, robust design, the U.S.S. Socrates is being heralded as the foremost Interceptor within the Federation.

ship_ability.title: Through the Veil
ship_ability.description: Increases Isolytic Damage by +{value} vs all oponents in the Veil (does not apply to Stations).
